meta_description: GB Plumbing offers expert plumbing services across Liverpool and surrounding areas. Fast response, competitive rates, and quality guaranteed. Call us today.
hero_eyebrow: Fully Insured — Fast Response Across Liverpool
hero_subhead: Leaks, boiler faults, or blocked drains — GB Plumbing gets to you fast and sorts the problem properly, first time.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full bathroom installations, GB Plumbing covers every plumbing need for homeowners and landlords across Merseyside.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, or sudden loss of water pressure — we respond fast to prevent damage to your home. Available for urgent callouts across Liverpool with no unnecessary delays.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Repairs
services.desc: Keep your boiler running safely and efficiently with a professional annual service or a swift repair when things go wrong. We work on all major boiler makes and models.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Toilets
services.desc: Persistent blockages are cleared quickly and cleanly using professional-grade equipment. We identify the root cause so the problem doesn't keep coming back.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: From a single fixture swap to a complete bathroom fit-out, our team delivers a high-quality finish on time and within budget. Supply only or full supply-and-fit available.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Hidden leaks can cause serious structural damage if left unchecked. We use proven techniques to pinpoint and repair leaks with minimal disruption to your property.

services.title: Central Heating & Radiators
services.desc: Cold spots, noisy radiators, or a heating system that won't balance — we diagnose and fix central heating problems to keep your home warm throughout the year.

about_pullquote: We take pride in leaving every job cleaner than we found it.
about_para_1: GB Plumbing was established to give Liverpool homeowners a plumber they could genuinely rely on — one who turns up on time, communicates clearly, and never cuts corners. Based in Garston, we've built our reputation street by street across the city, earning repeat custom through honest work and fair pricing.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is straightforward: we treat your home with respect, explain everything before we start, and don't leave until you're satisfied with the result. Whether it's a quick repair or a major installation, every job receives the same attention to detail that has made us a trusted name in the local community.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About GB Plumbing

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Called GB Plumbing on a Monday morning about a leaking pipe under the kitchen sink and they were with me by lunchtime. Sorted quickly, no mess left behind, and the price was exactly what was quoted. Couldn't ask for more.
reviews.author: Janet R.

reviews.text: Really impressed. My boiler packed in on one of the coldest nights of the year and GB Plumbing had it back up and running the following morning. The lad who came out was friendly, explained the fault clearly, and didn't try to oversell me anything. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Used GB Plumbing for a full bathroom installation and they did a cracking job. Turned up every day when they said they would, kept me informed throughout, and the finished result looks fantastic. Great value for the quality of work. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Claire B.
